senses.gloss:
r. 10th cl. (चुक्कयति)
To inflict or suffer pain.

m. (-रः)
The roaring of a lion.
E.
चुक्क pain, derived from चुक्क, with अच् affix, ऋ in the causal, to occasion, affix अप्.

m. (-क्रः)
1 Sorrel.
2 Sourness.
n. (-क्रं)
1 Acid seasoning.
2 Vinegar made by the acetous fermentation of grain.
f. (-क्रा or क्री)
1 Indian sorrel, (Rumex vesicarius.)
2 Hogplum.
3 The tamarind.
E.
चक to satisfy, Uṇādi affix रक्, and the radical vowel changed to उ; also with कन्, चुक्रक.

f. (-का)
Indian sorrel, (Rumex vesicarius.)
E.
कन् added to the preceding.
